title: Prototype a preservation-first compatibility envelope

authority_contract.source: The untouched source payload is the only authority.
authority_contract.derived_views: Reader views and Task recommendations are non-authoritative annotations.
authority_contract.competing_truths: Populated lower-precedence sources are reported as conflicts and never silently selected.

fallback_precedence.malformed_authoritative_source: Explicit supported error plus quarantine; lower precedence cannot mask it.

rollback: Remove the envelope and return source; semantic pre-image hash and residue set are verified for every fixture.
selection_authority: Experimenter reports evidence only and does not select a winner.
